_conformance: ART-DIRECTION.md §§2–7 + GI1–GI7; READER-CONTRACT §4 entries (supervisor merges into design/chapters.json). Classes plate/arch only. No reader-* classes. Plates FIXED dark on all themes (§3).

_directions.chosen: Within-cathedral exploration, per binding §6: the book identity APPROVED Direction 1 (Contemplative Cathedral); cohort brief requires exploring within the chosen grammar, not re-choosing. Three within-grammar studies: (A) Occupational plates — crossing lantern / rose / sanctuary as drawn architecture [CHOSEN]; (B) Emblem medallions — lamp, rose, altar as small centered devices [rejected: medallions shrink to stickers at 200px and repeat the banned label-on-panel shape at 3×]; (C) Plan-view diagrams — cruciform floor plan, rose tracery diagram, sanctuary elevation as engraved schematics [rejected: diagrams illustrate the BUILDING, not the ARGUMENT; the reboot-at-center lamp and mandate-as-rose-light need interior presence, not survey drawings].
references: Crossing (architecture) — en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Crossing_(architecture): the crossing as junction of four arms; tower/dome weight rests on the corners; lantern towers admit light down to the crossing → p1c9 corner piers + lit lantern ring.

Lantern tower — en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lantern_tower: tall windowed construction above the crossing; often octagonal with windows to lighten the load and admit light → p1c9 crenellated lantern with four lit lancets.
Rose window — en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rose_window: circular Gothic window divided by stone mullions and tracery → p1c10 twelve spokes + stone ring + glass petals.
Carceri d'invenzione — en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Carceri_d%27invenzione (via directions.md): Piranesi 2nd-state rule — bitten line + tonal mass, no mid-tone murk → GI3 binding on all plates.

_grammar.arc: Candle-dominant; most luminous plates. IX crossing lamp (light arrives at the center) → X rose light (Sanctuary Red's second sanctioned use) → XI full-light climax (may carry Vellum fields: altar mensa, east glass, candle wax).
_grammar.motif_logic: Descent-into-maze → mandate → new-structure, recast into cathedral grammar per conformance order: the Procedure's discontinuous reboot happens AT THE CENTER under a lit lantern (p1c9 crossing); the Mandate of Heaven is light admitted from above through a rose — power flowing down toward the worthy (p1c10 rose-window); the New Structure is the sanctuary in full light, the altar where undivided authority reigns (p1c11 sanctuary). Nothing dissolves/cracks/sheds (GI1/N1 absolute): all arches whole, all glass leaded, all stone intact.

p1c10.caption: Dose X · The rose
p1c10.composition: Rose centered in its ashlar wall under a pointed-arch frame; side lancets answer from the aisles; stepped rose-light wedges spill to the sill. Slot: #chapter-art above meta (§5 plate ~320px desktop, ≥200px phones).
p1c10.content_kind: doctrinal core: the Mandate of Heaven (Tianming), the Schelling point, the Antiversity as truth service, the Right Pole island of stability.
p1c10.end_seal: Rose seal: Sanctuary-Red ring + Candle hub + 8 spoke ticks (url() ≤32px, contract A.0).

grounds.quote: The spiritual core of the First Step is the famous and ancient Chinese principle of the Mandate of Heaven, or Tianming... power flows toward the worthy.
grounds.why: The plate IS this sentence: light admitted from above through the rose, flowing down toward the worthy below.

grounds.quote: To defeat the Modern Structure, create a New Structure which is more worthy to rule... power will flow to it—as the rains return to the ocean.
grounds.why: Rose-light wedges spill DOWN the wall to the floor: the rains returning to the ocean, drawn as stepped light.

grounds.quote: It had a red button, and under that red button was a little heat-printed plastic strip that said, in Cyrillic: SURRENDER TO AMERICA.
grounds.why: The rose's Sanctuary-Red glass is the chapter's red sanctioned: the eject-button red, transfigured into rose light (identity: red's second use).

grounds.quote: The only way to break this cycle is to create a Schelling point: a credible and precise alternative. A red button.
grounds.why: The rose is the Schelling point drawn: one centered, precise, unmissable device around which all eyes coordinate.

grounds.quote: We just replace its brain—the University. With a new device we call the Antiversity... an independent producer of veracity—a truth service.
grounds.why: The hub oculus: a single clear eye of gold glass at the rose's center — the truth service as the window's seeing heart.

grounds.quote: There is an isolated political maximum, or island of stability, several orders of magnitude to the right of the present-day political spectrum... the Right Pole.
grounds.why: The rose ring is the island drawn whole: a bounded, complete, self-sufficient circle set apart in the wall.

grounds.quote: Only now see you the true height of these fierce and snowy mountains. Tremble, glasshoppa. The mountains exist. But there is a path.
grounds.why: The pointed-arch frame around the rose: the path exists and it is arched — the mountain pass as a doorway of light.

p1c10.opener: Plate → DOSE X · PART I (Marcellus, Candle) → Marcellus title → candle rule → calm Source Serif body. Drop cap: Sanctuary Red Marcellus (large-only, 4.46:1; Candle fallback in CSS).
p1c10.palette_role: Sanctuary Red's second sanctioned use: twelve red petals + red spill feet; Candle inner trefoils + hub; the arc's red climax before XI goes full gold.
p1c10.reading: Calm body ≤68ch; no art behind prose. Long doctrinal paragraphs keep full measure; the rose light stays above the meta block only.
p1c10.title: The Mandate of Heaven

p1c11.caption: Dose XI · The sanctuary
p1c11.composition: Altar centered on three steps beneath the great east window; reredos arch frames the Sanctuary; twin candles + receding choir stalls flank; stepped window-light falls across altar and floor. Slot: #chapter-art above meta (§5).
p1c11.content_kind: climax: the Plinth as existential party, the Program, seizing power (direct/indirect coup), Belloc's conquest of ideas, closing Carlyle.
p1c11.end_seal: Sanctuary seal: Candle arch with gold field + pale flame (url() ≤32px, contract A.0) — the book's last mark is a lit arch.

grounds.quote: Once the Antiversity holds full sovereignty, it continues the Procedure, dissolving USG and replacing it with a New Structure of its own design.
grounds.why: The sanctuary IS the New Structure: the finished room, in full light, where the replacement stands complete.

grounds.quote: Can democracy terminate democracy?... elect a President who has promised to cancel the Constitution... the military must also support this autogolpe.
grounds.why: The altar on its steps: undivided sovereign authority in one place — the self-coup's single lawful seat, drawn as the high altar.

grounds.quote: The key safety change is that the Party is designed to seize power, but not hold power... a temporary organism—designed to win and die. Its career is its larval stage.
grounds.why: The twin candles: they burn to give light and are consumed — the win-and-die Plinth as sanctuary candles, not as ruins (GI1).

grounds.quote: Continue calling the project by its internal codename... the Plinth. Again... not only does the Plinth not exist, it cannot exist until the Antiversity exists.
grounds.why: The altar mensa on its stepped base: the Plinth drawn literally — the stepped platform on which the new order stands.

grounds.quote: The direct coup is harder and more dangerous... the Plinth never fails. If it would fail, it doesn't try.
grounds.why: The east window's unbroken tracery + whole glass: the never-fail standard drawn as unblemished craft — nothing cracked, nothing mended.

grounds.quote: It is the pressure and at last the conquest of ideas when they have this three-fold power: first, that they are novel... secondly... conviction... thirdly... a system.
grounds.why: The mensa's three gilt frontal panels: Belloc's three-fold power as three gold tablets on the altar front.

grounds.quote: Better Boethius than Claudian, I say. Better truth in a cage than lies in purple. Truth will not remain in a cage, nor lies in purple.
grounds.why: The full-light east glass: truth out of the cage — the book's brightest field, Vellum-pale, at the very end of the walk.

grounds.quote: 'Nay, by God, Donald, we must help him to mend it!'
grounds.why: The book's closing imperative hangs over the altar: the sanctuary is not a ruin to admire but a work to complete — mending, not mourning.

p1c11.opener: Plate (most luminous of the eleven) → DOSE XI · PART I → Marcellus title → candle rule → calm body. Drop cap: Marcellus Candle ('In this chapter, we're going to step boldly forward…').
p1c11.palette_role: Full-light climax: Vellum fields sanctioned (altar mensa, east glass, candle wax); Candle dominant; Sanctuary Red only in ember accents (flame bases, frontal rules).
p1c11.reading: Calm body ≤68ch; 155 paras (longest chapter) get zero opener interference — plate, meta, then uninterrupted prose to the sanctuary seal.
p1c11.title: The New Structure

p1c9.caption: Dose IX · The crossing
p1c9.composition: Lantern tower centered above; four arches (nave/choir/transepts) meet at the crossing square; corner piers carry the weight; lamp hangs at center on its chain; stepped light wedges fall from lantern to floor. Slot: #chapter-art above meta (§5 plate ~320px desktop, ≥200px phones).
p1c9.content_kind: procedural hinge: Reboot vs revolution, the Three Steps, passivism's steel rule, Law of Sewage, Hitler-prevention.
p1c9.end_seal: Crossing seal: Candle arch outline + centered flame (url() ≤32px, contract A.0).

grounds.quote: Out of the Computer's infinite fluorescent maze. Into the glorious air of pure, unfiltered reason. The last hatch is unlocked above your head. The ladder is at your feet.
grounds.why: The lantern tower IS the unlocked hatch overhead: light admitted from above the crossing; the hanging lamp-chain is the ladder at the reader's feet, recast as the sanctuary lamp.

grounds.quote: The Reaction is an ideal plan for a discontinuous transition of sovereignty, or reboot. The Procedure is what you can do, dear reader, to help make the Reaction happen.
grounds.why: The crossing square: four arms meeting at ONE discontinuous center — the reboot drawn as the place where separate structures share a single instant of transition.

grounds.quote: So, at 11:59:59 p.m. on Reaction Eve, the Constitution... is as valid as ever... At 12:00:00 a.m. on Reaction Day, the Constitution is out and Chuck is in.
grounds.why: The lamp lit at the center: the 12:00:00 moment — one flame, already burning, marking the discontinuous instant. (No clock face: the identity forbids gimmick overlays; the lit lamp is the timestamp.)

grounds.quote: A reboot has about as much in common with your common, or garden, revolution as a beautiful young woman has with a Gila monster. The two are, quite simply, opposites.
grounds.why: GI1 compliance as content: the plate shows a reboot that BUILDS (lit lantern, whole arches) — the opposite of revolution's ruin. Nothing dissolves, because the Reaction doesn't destroy.

grounds.quote: There is only one dark, half-magical art that can produce reliable quality on the first try... It is called engineering... Political engineering is rocket science, too.
grounds.why: The corner piers + strainer arches: load-bearing engineering drawn honestly — the tower's weight rests on the corners (Crossing ref), the engineer's answer to 'work perfectly on the first try'.

grounds.quote: The Procedure comes in Three Steps: 1. Become worthy. / 2. Accept power. / 3. Rule!!1!1
grounds.why: Three stepped light wedges fall from lantern to floor: the Three Steps as descending grades of light — worthy, accept, rule — arriving at the crossing floor.

grounds.quote: The steel rule of passivism is absolute renunciation of official power... absolute renunciation of power over USG implies absolute submission to the Structure.
grounds.why: The lamp hangs on a steel chain from above: held power suspended, renounced, awaiting acceptance — the steel rule as a hanging lamp, not a raised weapon.

grounds.quote: The Law is: if you put a drop of wine in a barrel of sewage, you get sewage. If you put a drop of sewage in a barrel of wine, you get sewage.
grounds.why: The lamp's glass is Sanctuary Red but the FLAME is pure Candle-gold: the vessel may hold anything, but what burns at the center is uncontaminated — the Law of Sewage answered by a quarantined flame.

p1c9.opener: Plate → DOSE IX · PART I (Marcellus, Candle) → Marcellus title → candle rule (Ashen + flame pip) → calm Source Serif body. Drop cap: Marcellus Candle on 'Today you begin…' (P0, long, declarative — warranted).
p1c9.palette_role: Candle arrives: lit lantern ring + lamp flame + spill wedges carry the chapter; Sanctuary Red only in lamp glass + flame base. First plate where light dominates stone (GI2 hinge).
p1c9.reading: Calm body ≤68ch; no art behind prose. The 130-para procedural argument reads uninterrupted; opener ambition stays above the meta block.
p1c9.title: The Procedure and the Reaction
